_about: Photo shape targets for HR 26 V10. Full-scale mm, x from bow, z above DWL unless stated. 'today_model' = baseline_fine / params.py value.

targets.name: rub_rail_visible_height
targets.method: FWHM of the dark band along the whole hull in IMG_9370 = 4.3 px = 42 mm mean after back-projection (35-51 along length); IMG_9391 close-up 25-29 px at ~1.3-1.5 mm/px = 33-43 mm; IMG_9387 band is 0.25 x window-frame height (includes shadowed underside)

targets.name: rub_rail_protrusion
targets.method: head-on silhouette: step between rail outer edge and the hull continuing below it = 10-15 px at the max-beam distance (~2.65 mm/px with the fitted camera)

targets.name: rub_rail_profile
targets.value: dark (black/dark grey) rubber D-profile with rounded face; underside reflects sky; continuous from stem head (wraps under bow-roller fitting, no flat end) round both stern quarters and across the transom
targets.method: visual
targets.today_model: 95x55 rectangle, ruled loft, flat end at x=200, knuckles at stern corner

targets.name: rub_rail_centre_z_vs_strake_z
targets.uncertainty: +-15 mm (the fit uses strake_z, so this only shows consistency)
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm; residual of the photo rail centre against strake_z along x=170-7600 is within +-1.4 px

targets.name: rub_rail_below_deck_edge_bow
targets.method: stem head top v=1221-1222 vs rail centre v=1230-1231 at x=0-300 (8-10 px)

targets.name: rub_rail_below_deck_edge_transom
targets.method: near transom top corner v~1219 vs rail end v~1233 at the stern (14 px)

targets.name: deck_edge_minus_rail_centre_amidships_min
targets.method: window frame top is 31.7 px = 315 mm above the rail centre at x~4200-4800 (independent of camera elevation); the deck edge must be above it (coachroof base and roof-edge lines put it ~1.3 px higher)

targets.name: deck_edge_z_amidships_min
targets.uncertainty: +-25 mm (lower bound; assumes rail at strake_z)
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm; window frame top back-projects to z 1161 (x 4236), 1144 (x 4807), 1115 (x 5430)

targets.name: deck_edge_z_bow
targets.method: stem head top v 1221-1222 back-projected (drawing 1204 projects to v 1222.4)

targets.name: window_x_forward_end
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm; forward extreme of frame u=577.5

targets.name: window_x_aft_end
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm; aft extreme of frame u=745.5

targets.name: window_length
targets.method: difference of the two ends; NOTE conflicts with the 1:50 drawing (3666-4841) - verify before changing

targets.name: window_frame_height
targets.method: frame top v 1222 to bottom v 1248 (26 px) at u 600-735

targets.name: window_glass_height
targets.method: glass v 1226-1245

targets.name: window_frame_top_above_rail_centre
targets.method: 31.7 px above the rail centre, independent of camera elevation

targets.name: window_frame_bottom_above_rail_centre
targets.method: 5.6 px in IMG_9370; 0.10 of the rail-to-sheer distance in IMG_9387

targets.name: window_frame_top_z
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm

targets.name: window_forward_end_shape
targets.value: semicircular, R ~ half frame height = ~125 mm
targets.method: visual on zoomed crops

targets.name: window_aft_end_shape
targets.value: rounded and raked: bottom corner ~85 mm aft of top corner (end leans forward at the top, ~18 deg)
targets.method: u 735 (top) vs 744 (bottom) in IMG_9370

targets.name: window_frame_rim_width
targets.method: raised light-grey frame 5-6 px wide on a 57 px frame height

targets.name: boot_top_band_height
targets.method: blue band 8-11 px (top edge to first red)

targets.name: boot_top_pinstripe
targets.method: light/cream stripe directly under the blue band, 0.17-0.27 x band height

targets.name: boot_top_top_edge_above_waterline_amidships
targets.method: 10-13 px above the red antifouling / water contact at u 400-650

targets.name: boot_top_sheer_rise_at_ends
targets.method: top edge z: 126 (x1380), 108 (2786), 93 (4209), 94 (5163), 116 (6121), 134 (6602) via fitted camera; absolute z +-60 mm (camera elevation)

targets.name: stem_profile_above_water
targets.method: stem outline v 1236-1322 fitted, rms 0.7 px

targets.name: transom_rake
targets.method: aft outline u 985->975 over v 1232->1290

targets.name: mast_x_at_coachroof
targets.method: orthographic camera fitted to IMG_9370 (roll -2.1 deg, yaw 2.7 deg, elevation 7.1 deg, 9.56 x 9.89 mm/px) using the drawing stem profile (rms 0.7 px), stem head (1204) and rub-rail centre line strake_z (rms 1.0 px = 10 mm); points back-projected onto the near hull side y = deck half-breadth - 20..30 mm; mast centre u=526.5 at v=1000 minus ~40 mm assumed aft rake

targets.name: coachroof_side_height
targets.method: coachroof base line v~1214 to roof-edge line v~1189 at u 440-620 (25 px)

targets.name: stem_round_radius
targets.method: width of the shading transition across the stem = 45-55 px at ~1.06 mm/px (stem 1.9-2.3 m from the fitted camera, f=1888 px); R = width/(2 cos 25 deg)

targets.name: bow_waterline_halfbreadth_z130
targets.method: boot-top top edge (left arm, 32 points) back-projected onto the plane z=130 with the camera fitted to the rail silhouette, stem line and keel

targets.name: topside_halfbreadth_x3550_z270_440
targets.method: head-on silhouette below the rail; photo ray intersected at the depth of today's silhouette generator (x~3550); the real outline lies 1.1 deg (33-37 px) outside today's

targets.name: topside_silhouette_flare_below_rail
targets.value: 5 deg just under the rail, 7 deg at -0.15 m, 11 deg at -0.3 m, 15 deg at -0.45 m (convex: flare increases downwards)
targets.method: slope of the right-hand silhouette between rows 635 and 800 (near-level camera, pitch 4 deg)
targets.today_model: outline pulls in immediately under the rail (hollow; includes the 95x55 rail underside), then runs straight

targets.name: topside_convexity_vs_chord
targets.method: silhouette bulge relative to the chord rail-bottom -> boot-top end (rows 635-790), ~5 px at 2.65-3 mm/px

targets.name: deck_edge_rounding
targets.value: soft, small radius ~15-25 mm; no separate toe rail visible
targets.method: visual (highlight width)

targets.name: bow_fitting
targets.value: plough anchor on a stainless bow roller above the stem head, projecting ~200-300 mm forward
targets.method: visual
targets.today_model: 520x170 anchor-roller brick reaching below the deck

targets.name: stern_outline_halfwidth_ratio_boottop_to_rail
targets.method: outline from astern (silhouette) at the boot-top level / at the rail-corner level, rudder as centre line
targets.today_model: 0.84 (max half-breadth x7600-7800 at z=100 / rail level, perspective weighted)

targets.name: transom_boottop_straight_fraction
targets.method: boot-top top edge is a straight line over u 300-1000; rail corners at u ~-15 and 1275

targets.name: transom_side_corner
targets.value: no crease: the transom face blends into the quarters with a large soft radius (est. 100-250 mm in plan at rail level, more at the boot-top); boot-top and rail turn smoothly round it
targets.method: shading and line curvature at the corners
targets.today_model: sharp face edge (R0), deck corner R~290 in plan only

targets.name: transom_outline_shape
targets.method: right/left silhouette read on a 10 px grid, normalised to the rail level

targets.name: transom_rail_arch
targets.value: rail across the transom arches ~100 px above its corner chord (sagitta/half-width ~0.16 in the image)
targets.uncertainty: plan camber + view from below; consistent with plan camber R~2000-3000, cannot be separated
targets.method: rail centre tracked u 0-1240

targets.name: rail_on_transom_below_top
targets.method: see rub_rail_below_deck_edge_transom

targets.name: forehatch
targets.value: on the coachroof just forward of the mast; near-square, ~0.4 of the local coachroof width
targets.method: visual

targets.name: coachroof_front_plan
targets.method: visual

targets.name: sprayhood
targets.value: soft dome over the companionway: raked front, rounded aft hoop (no flat ends), side windows; spans most of the coachroof width; top ~300-370 mm above the roof
targets.method: visual; height from IMG_9374 against the window frame
targets.today_model: loaf with flat vertical ends, swallows winches

targets.name: cockpit_coaming
targets.value: low, rounded top edges, fades into the aft deck towards the stern
targets.method: visual

targets.name: winches
targets.value: one small primary winch each side on the coaming at the forward end of the cockpit, clear of the sprayhood
targets.method: visual
